sectors.implications: Energy inflation risk to persist into Q4; refineries become strategic bottleneck; oil prices supported but demand concerns linger

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from consumer weakness, inflation resurgence, and midterm election anxiety. AI names may rotate but capex cycle supports tech. Energy and gold benefit from geopolitical risk. Expect elevated volatility into Q4 earnings season. Dow futures rising but breadth concerns persist.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle remains primary growth driver through 2027. Consumer deceleration may moderate as Fed eases. Housing correction likely to continue. Buffett transition creates uncertainty in value investing paradigm. AI governance regulation will reshape tech landscape. Energy infrastructure constraints support commodity prices structurally.
